scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev:worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w shared && npm run test:unit -w backend
